notify.noGM: Quick Map Markers: a GM has to be online to place or change markers.
notify.noPermission: You may only change markers you placed yourself.

playersCanPlace.name: Players can place markers
playersCanPlace.hint: If off, only GMs can place markers by double-clicking the scene.

everyoneCanEdit.name: Everyone can edit every marker
everyoneCanEdit.hint: If off, players can only rename or remove markers they placed themselves. GMs can always edit all markers.

markerScale.name: Marker size
markerScale.hint: Marker size relative to one grid square.
